requests.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: Victoria 3 production-method (PM) raster UI icon, transparent.
Input images: Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, the existing flat PM. Images 2, 3 and 4 are native vanilla STYLE REFERENCES only, not subjects to insert.
Primary request: Change ONLY the surface treatment of Image 1. Add a fine, restrained, irregular matte granular pigment texture to the beige/ochre fills, similar to the gently grained native references. It must no longer look like smooth cut paper.
Add one coherent VERTICAL TOP-TO-BOTTOM COLOR GRADIENT across the entire icon: clearly lighter warm ivory/beige at the top, gradually becoming darker muted sand/ochre-brown at the bottom, about 25-30% lower brightness at the bottom. This is a flat graphic color gradient, NOT lighting on a 3D object. Make the top-to-bottom difference noticeable at 64px. Fine grain must remain subtle, not coarse spots, cracks or noise that destroys the symbol.
Invariants: preserve the original subject, exact silhouette, number of components, proportions, placement, orientation, framing, dark brown contours and transparent openings. Do not redesign or add elements. Apply the grain and gradient inside the existing painted silhouette only. All external background and all original internal cutouts MUST remain truly transparent. Keep the whole icon equally sharp.
Avoid: relief, bevel, embossing, rim highlights, cast/drop shadows, 3D depth, glossy metal, realistic material rendering, perspective changes, floor, frame, badge, text, labels, numbers, extra symbols, watermark. No physical paper fibers, folded/torn paper or cut-paper layered edges. Do not make the bottom black.
Output: one square raster PNG, at least 1024x1024, genuine alpha transparency, same margins as Image 1.
Subject identity to preserve: Distillation fractionnée (fractional_distillation_refinery).
